[EN] There's a problem on the road to Lee's End Stead. Hyenas have been stalking the path between farms, killing livestock and attacking merchants.

, could you take care of the beasts for us? Lee's End Stead is east of here.

When you're done hunting the hyenas, please report to Cregan; you'll find him out on the road.
[ES] Hay un problema en el camino hacia Lee's End Stead. Unas hienas han estado acechando el sendero entre granjas, matando ganado y atacando a los comerciantes.

, ¿podrías ocuparte de las bestias por nosotros? Lee's End Stead está al este de aquí.

Cuando termines de cazar las hienas, preséntate ante Cregan; lo encontrarás en el camino.

[EN] Are you ? I'm assuming you've hunted a horde of those hyenas, and now you're after the reward?
[ES] ¿Eres ? Supongo que has estado cazando una horda de esas hienas y ahora vas tras la recompensa.
